description: Write Book 4 of 9: '오멜라스: 판관기 (Omelas: Judges)' in Korean. The conflict escalates into open judgment/tribunal: the Evils/Scientists put baptism and World 3.0 on trial (literally or morally), while the Goods and Evangelists judge the resistance as heretics. Explores who has the right to judge, and the 'half-baked scientists' who argue FOR baptism. Depends on FEAT-001; follows Books 1-3.
steps: Write ~5-6 Korean chapters centered on judgment: a tribunal or reckoning, the presentation of scientific facts against baptism, the counter-arguments of half-baked scientists who defend it, and the Goods rendering verdicts. Feature the robot-Good who argues robots should become human as a dissenting judge.
Advance the arcs of the recurring characters established in the story bible.
acceptance_criteria: books/04-judges/ contains 00-index.md and >=5 Korean chapter files.
Explores judgment/tribunal theme with both anti- and pro-baptism scientist voices, consistent with canon.
verification: Run: ls books/04-judges/ and confirm files exist.
Run: cat books/04-judges/chapter-*.md | wc -m and confirm ~11,000-14,000 characters.
Spot-read a chapter for Korean prose and continuity.
